data.gender_notes: Barisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Barisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vasna' meaning 'desire'. It is a feminine name that symbolizes the fulfillment of desires and the bringing of prosperity. The name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Barisha carries the meaning “Bringer of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Barisha usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Barisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barisha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Barisha was a prominent Hindu king of the Sena Dynasty in Bengal during the 11th and 12th centuries. He is known for expanding the Sena kingdom and defeating the Pala rulers.

Barisha is also known as Bhagirathi Roy Chaudhuri, and he is mentioned in various ancient Hindu texts and inscriptions, including the 'Ain-i-Akbari' of Emperor Akbar's time. He was a renowned scholar and a devout Hindu, and is believed to have founded several temples and patronized learning.
